title: select_channel can return index == num_channels (off-by-one)
description:
File: python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py:89

select_channel returns out-of-bounds index: formula `1 + (h % num_channels)` can return `num_channels`, which exceeds valid array bounds [0, num_channels-1].

**Failure scenario:** With EU868 (8 channels), epoch=2, eui64=0x0011223344556677, select_channel returns 8. Calling frequency(8) raises ValueError because valid indices are 0-7. Probability: 1/num_channels (12.5% for EU868).

**Verdict:** CONFIRMED
